item.title: Binary Search
item.description: Binary Search Binary Search is a searching algorithm that operates on a sorted or monotonic search space, repeatedly dividing it into halves to find a target value or optimal answer in logarithmic time O(log N).

item.title: Recursion
item.description: Recursion Recursion in Python is a powerful concept where a function solves a problem by calling itself with a simpler version of the same problem, mirroring how we break down complex tasks in everyday thinking.
